meta.name: afx
meta.description: Agent Farm CLI — the tool for spawning builders, managing Tower, workspaces, and cron tasks. ALWAYS consult this skill BEFORE running any `afx` command to get the exact syntax. This prevents wasting time guessing flags that don't exist. Use this whenever you need to spawn a builder, check status, send messages, clean up worktrees, manage Tower, or run cron tasks. If you're about to type `afx` followed by anything, check here first.

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理多 agent 构建与任务调度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从命令行管理多个 agent 工作流和定时任务。
copy.tagline_en: Manage multi-agent builds and task scheduling from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple agent workflows and cron tasks from the CLI.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 `afx` 命令来生成 builder、管理 Tower 和工作区、执行定时任务、检查状态、发送消息、清理工作树等，并使用正确的命令行语法。
howto.when: 当你需要运行任何 `afx` 命令时触发，例如生成 builder、检查状态、发送消息、清理工作树、管理 Tower 或执行定时任务。
howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can run `afx` commands to spawn builders, manage Tower and workspaces, handle cron tasks, check status, send messages, clean up worktrees, etc., using the correct command syntax.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to run any `afx` command, such as spawning a builder, checking status, sending messages, cleaning up worktrees, managing Tower, or running cron tasks.

say_en.text: Use `afx spawn 42 --protocol spir` to start a SPIR builder for issue #42.
say_en.note: Spawns a SPIR protocol builder for issue #42.

say_en.text: Run `afx status` to see all builders and workspace status.
say_en.note: Displays all active builders and Tower status.

say_en.text: Send a message to builder 0585: `afx send 0585 "PR approved, please merge"`.
say_en.note: Sends a message to the specified builder.
